Name: (CP)(MMAP)Wherewindsmeet Qinghe
Author: umganil
Description:
for the long wait~! This is the second installment of the wherewindsmeet series:Qinghe.
For players who are not interested in wherewindsmeet, you can use it as an ordinary ancient Chinese style furniture package.[left]
------------------------------- Suggestions for use:--------------------------------------------------------

[list]
[*]The furniture catalog is available for purchase from Robin.
[*]This is the Qinghe chapter of the Yanyun series, mainly featuring Qinghe furniture as the theme of interior furniture (including a small amount of Kaifeng furniture, but most of the more gorgeous Kaifeng furniture will still be released in the Kaifeng chapter). The furniture itself is placed both indoors and outdoors.
[*]It is strongly recommended to use with Happy Home Designer (19675) and Precision Furniture ( 23488)!
[*]This version doesn't have many special features, but it still requires MMAP as a prerequisite to ensure that the partitions are passable and the lights are positioned correctly.
[*]For players who don’t play WhereWindsMeet, you can use this as ordinary antique style furniture.
[*]I18n files are used. If you want to translate, feel free to do so.！
[/list][/left]
Suggestions for use:
The furniture catalog is available for purchase from Robin.
It is strongly recommended to use with Happy Home Designer (ending number 19675) and Precision Furniture (ending number 23488)!
